description: BEopt™ (Building Energy Optimization Tool) version 3.0.1 3/16/2023 [SWR-05-41] is a software deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Craig Christensen, Scott Horowitz (National Renewable Energy Lab. (NREL), Golden, CO (United States)). The BEopt™ (Building Energy Optimization Tool) software provides capabilities to evaluate residential building designs and identify cost-optimal efficiency packages at various levels of whole-house energy savings along the path to zero net energy. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes.
